command_priority: PRESERVE RECON AND STRIKE CADRE, BUT EXPLOIT FIXED BOMBARDMENT GEOMETRY. Unlike the invisible carrier task groups, the battleship/minesweeper force off Saipan presents a fresh local target that can be attacked without a blind ocean search.

reconnaissance_result.morning: Surviving land/float reconnaissance confirms heavy battleships shelling Saipan and reports minesweeping/reef activity. At least one snooper is lost to US CAP, consistent with the strong American screen.
reconnaissance_result.information_quality: AMPHIBIOUS-INTENT QUALITY for strategic decision; not weapon-quality against TF58 carrier groups.

local_air_counterattack.target: TG58.7/bombardment and nearby support screen, not a speculative anti-carrier search.
local_air_counterattack.result: Several attackers reach release geometry, but CAP and heavy AA break up the attack. No fast battleship receives a confirmed hit; a screening ship is lightly/moderately damaged by near miss/fragments. The attack forces the US to maintain substantial CAP and confirms that surviving Japanese aviation remains tactically relevant.

end_13Jun.interpretation: Marianas aviation is now a damaged reconnaissance/local-strike system rather than a theater air-superiority force, but it remains capable of detecting close amphibious geometry and generating limited attacks.
